name: logo-cloud
title: Logo cloud
description: Static customer marks in a centred wrapping row or responsive grid with a localized caption above or beside the logos. Apps supply single-colour currentColor SVGs. Marks inherit muted-foreground; use the high_contrast theme or text-foreground on the root or an item for thin marks. Empty logo arrays render nothing. No animation, filters or masks.
author: gntik-ai
